environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU

reproduce: uv run seqrec train --name sasrec --dataset ml-1m --split-strategy loo --max-seq-len 100 --hidden-size 64 --num-layers 2 --num-heads 2 --dropout 0.2 --loss-type ce --ggnn-steps 1 --share-item-embeddings --batch-size 256 --eval-batch-size 256 --epochs 200 --lr 0.001 --weight-decay 0.0001 --grad-clip 5.0 --patience 10 --val-every 1 --use-amp --seed 42 --device cuda --exp-name sasrec_ml-1m_loo_n100

eval_protocol.sampled_rank_rule: score desc, item id asc (item ids, not candidate columns)
eval_protocol.history_sampled_metrics: removed: per-epoch sampled_* values were produced under the pre-fix column-order tie-break and cannot be recomputed without per-epoch weights; protocol-consistent sampled metrics are reported in test_metrics and best_val_metrics only
